Maya (SecOps): Quick sync — SOC2/ISO milestone: audit-log backfill + KMS/HSM attestation. Need ownership + blockers. TL;DR: who owns the backfill, who owns HSM attestation? Adding dependency list shortly. See checklist: https://redwood-internal/docs/compliance/soc2-checklist :eyes:
Ivy (Eng): Backfill = me + data-platform. Will add ticket refs into the board. Need ETA by Mon EOD to keep rollout on track. Pinging @Samir for KMS handoff details.
Samir: I'm owning KMS/HSM integration (SEC-435). I have a draft attestation artifact and a short maintenance plan. Need PR review on the attestation tooling (PR #3421).
Alex P: I left comments on PR #3421 — can take another pass today after lunch. Also we need sample log schema before backfill runs.
Maya (SecOps): Cool. Ivy, can you paste the ticket list + quick dependency matrix here? I'll sync the milestone board and escalate any cross-team blockers.
Ivy (Eng): Tickets: `PLAT-918` (backfill), `LOGS-220` (schema), `SEC-435` (kms attestation). Dependency graph: PLAT-918 <- LOGS-220, PLAT-918 <- SEC-435. Owners: PLAT-918: Ivy; LOGS-220: Ryan; SEC-435: Samir.
Ryan (DataPlatform): Confirmed for LOGS-220. ETA Wed (end of day) to push schema and sample payloads to s3://redwood-compliance/samples.
Samir: For SEC-435 I need a short maintenance window to attach HSM proof. Proposed Fri 23:00-01:00 PT. Is that workable?
Jae: Ops can cover the window and own the runbook. +1 from oncall.
Ivy (Eng): One potential blocker: we can't run PLAT-918 until the attestation artifact is in place. If SEC-435 slips a day, backfill waits a day.
Samir: Understood. I'll upload the attestation artifact and example outputs to internal drive and link here by EOD today: https://redwood-internal/attestations/sec-435/example.tar.gz
Alex P: Noted — I'll finish the PR review today and reply to Samir's comments.
Maya (SecOps): Action items summary: Ivy — update PLAT-918 with dependency tags + due Mon EOD; Ryan — push LOGS-220 schema Wed; Samir — upload attestation artifact EOD and confirm maintenance window; Alex — finalize PR review today; Jae/Ops — own runbook for Fri window. I'll update the milestone board and ping compliance for signoff on Fri. :thumbsup:
